absent: Perf buffer allocation, mapping, event scheduling and common output begin internals beyond the shown wrappers and reclamation paths.
Hardware breakpoint slot arbitration, constraint solver and architecture slot query behavior.
Uprobe registration, unregistration, consumption, mapping handling and architecture instruction analysis.
Kunit assertion and skip semantics, thread lifecycle, and online processor iteration guarantees.
Auxiliary PMU driver interaction, record encoding, and userspace head and tail protocol.

findings.text: Hardware breakpoint self test suite exercises slot exhaustion across processor targeted and task targeted counters on one, many, all and mixed placements, expecting resource exhaustion once capacity is filled and checking that releasing entries restores creation in specified placements.

Test helpers create one byte read write kernel counters addressed at per index storage, cache readable slot count, skip cases needing more slots than available, track created events in a fixed table, and on teardown release every entry, stop the helper thread and assert global breakpoint use is clear.
Suite setup requires at least two online processors and an otherwise idle breakpoint facility, otherwise the case is skipped.

Perf ring buffer object combines lifetime accounting and reclamation linkage, data page counts and mode flags, poll state, writer position and nesting plus event and wakeup accounting and loss count, watermarks, event list with spin protection, mmap accounting with user ownership, a large auxiliary section with its own mutex positions watermarks page accounting callbacks and private storage, a shared user page, and trailing data page pointers.
Ring buffer serializes event list mutation with a spinlock and auxiliary area management with a mutex, while writer nesting counters and auxiliary nesting markers detect unsupported reentry.

Buffer reclamation has a direct path releasing user and data pages and a deferred path that schedules work whose handler releases virtual mapping and object storage, plus a read copy update callback that releases user accounting before delegating to the direct path.
Forward and backward output reservation entries forward to a shared begin operation with a direction selection.

Output copy layer offers plain memory copy, no effect skip, and user source copy performed with page faults disabled, plus recursion tracking that rejects a second entry at the same interrupt context level.

Auxiliary session moves from idle to active on begin which pins the parent buffer and auxiliary reference, rejects missing auxiliary storage or closing mappings or nested entry, publishes handle position and computes available space from head and tail against watermark, and on empty space disables the event wakes consumers and unwinds; an active session ends with end or advances with skip and returns auxiliary private storage only while active.

Auxiliary completion distinguishes overwrite from bounded modes for head update and flag handling, emits an auxiliary notification only when size or meaningful flags are present, publishes head to userspace, evaluates watermark wakeup, and disables the event when truncation is indicated.
Auxiliary watermark wakeup never fires in overwrite mode and otherwise advances a rounded wakeup marker when head progress reaches the watermark.
Auxiliary to main buffer copy walks a masked wrapped range page by page and reports fault on incomplete transfer, using a non reclaiming zeroing allocation mask for auxiliary pages.

Uprobe object links into a global tree, carries a reference count, separate registration and consumer semaphores, pending and consumer lists, inode ownership, a union for deferred reclamation, file offsets for probe and reference counter, flag word sized for bit operations, and architecture specific instruction state.
Out of line execution area holds a wait queue for slot exhaustion, a free slot bitmap, a backing page, and the saved virtual start of the mapping rather than a pointer to the mapping itself.

Uprobe tree access is serialized by a read write lock bound to a sequence counter, delayed installation list by a mutex, and mapping operations by a small hashed mutex array indexed from the mapping address.
Empty probe tree is detected from root emptiness and slot capacity per page is derived from page size over slot size with maximum slots equal to that quotient.
Ring buffer writable marker has value 1.
Maximum test breakpoints is 512.
Uprobe mapping mutex hash size is 13 and copy instruction marker is 0.
Auxiliary allocation mask combines kernel, zeroing, no warning and no retry properties.
Auxiliary overwrite indication supplied by callers is rejected, nested auxiliary entry follows a one time warning path, and out of space auxiliary begin disables the event before waking.
Test registration warns on out of range index and on null or error event pointer during unregister, and warns on negative processor selection.
